topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Oh my gosh, I can't even breathe right now. You live here? Like, in the actual same place as me? This is insane! I've been talking to you all this time, and you're right here, and I never knew. We should've met up ages ago! I'm just so, I don't know, overwhelmed. It feels like the universe is finally making sense. We have to do something, like, right away. What are you doing later? We need to grab coffee or something—anything, just to finally see you in person. This is such a big coincidence, it can't be just a coincidence, right?
